'''First Dawn''',<ref name="TM">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref> also known as '''first sunrise'''<ref name="TGM">{{GamerCite|1|Tatooine Grudge Match}}</ref> was the term used by Tatooinians to describe the rising of [[Tatoo I/Legends|Tatoo I]] in the morning on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TM" />
